title: matthiola littorea
intro: Matthiola littorea, commonly known as sea stock or horned poppy, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Matthiola littorea are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it an effective treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
